.. _advanced-pdes:

Advanced PDEs
-------------

These examples demonstrate more advanced usage of the package.

.. raw:: html

    <style>
 .image-container {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-block;
    }

    .image {
        display: block;
        width: 100%; /* 根据需求调整图片大小 */
    }

    .caption {
        display: none;
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
        color: white;
        padding: 10px;
        font-size: 16px;
    }

    .image-container:hover .image {
        display: none;
    }

    .image-container:hover .caption {
        display: block;
    }
    </style>

   <div class="image-container">
       <a href="index.html">
          <img src="_static/image/question.jpg" alt="Image" class="image" />
       </a>
       <div class="caption">这是图片的说明。</div>
   </div>
